headline: FOMC Preview: Fed likely to hold rates despite oil spike, Citi sees dovish outcome
summary: Investing.com -- The Federal Reserve is likely to leave interest rates unchanged at its July policy meeting despite rising oil prices, with Citi arguing that markets are overstating the chances of an immediate rate hike as recent inflation and labor market data point to easing price pressures.
